definitions.explanation: Not specifically identified or determined. Refers to people, things, or quantities that are not pinpointed or limited to particular individuals or items.

examples.japanese: {不特定|ふとくてい}{多数|たすう}の{人|ひと}が{利用|りよう}する{施設|しせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is a facility used by an unspecified large number of people.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{不特定|ふとくてい}の{人物|じんぶつ}を{狙|ねら}っていた。
examples.english: The criminal was targeting unspecified individuals.

examples.japanese: インターネット{上|じょう}では{不特定|ふとくてい}{多数|たすう}に{情報|じょうほう}が{公開|こうかい}されるため、{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いに{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Since information is made public to an unspecified large number of people on the internet, care must be taken when handling personal information.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {不|ふ} (not) + {特定|とくてい} (specified, identified). Most commonly appears in the set phrase {不特定|ふとくてい}{多数|たすう} (unspecified large number [of people]), which is extremely common in legal, administrative, and news contexts. Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns using の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不特定|ふとくてい}{多数|たすう} (an unspecified large number of people — the most common usage)
- {不特定|ふとくてい}の{人物|じんぶつ} (an unidentified person)
- {不特定|ふとくてい}の{相手|あいて} (an unspecified counterpart)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {特定|とくてい}: specified, identified — the opposite
- {不明|ふめい}: unknown, unclear — indicates information is not available, whereas {不特定|ふとくてい} implies no attempt to specify
